title: ReplayVerification
description: Verification result from the DeterministicReplay engine. All 5 checks must pass for deterministic guarantee.

projectionRoot1.description: First run projection root hashes (JSON-serialized map)

projectionRoot2.description: Second run projection root hashes (JSON-serialized map)

rootsMatch.description: Whether projection roots match between runs

canonicalBytesMatch.description: Whether canonical bytes are identical between runs

signaturesMatch.description: Whether signatures are identical between runs

mmrRootsMatch.description: Whether MMR roots are identical between runs

factIdsMatch.description: Whether fact IDs are identical between runs

deterministic.description: True only if ALL 5 checks pass
